target: Validate a claim about gpu scheduling using a GPU lease and cleanup protocol. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Validate gpu scheduling — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about gpu scheduling using a GPU lease and cleanup protocol. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

topic_kernel.artifact: a GPU lease and cleanup protocol
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: leaving stale processes in allocated VRAM

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a GPU lease and cleanup protocol.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report utilization, contention and recovery time with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: leaving stale processes in allocated VRAM.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of gpu scheduling.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report utilization, contention and recovery time against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for leaving stale processes in allocated VRAM; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
